title: Version 2.1.79 - Console Authentication and Remote Control
description: Added --console flag for Anthropic Console authentication, /remote-control command for VSCode to bridge sessions to claude.ai/code, and show turn duration toggle. Fixed multiple issues including voice mode activation, Ctrl+C in print mode, and improved startup memory usage by ~18MB.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code VS Code extension is now incredible! I am absolutely floored with how good the claude code vs code extension works versus what it used to be
VSCode extension extremely slow autocomplete after updating to latest version v2.1.29

title: Version v0.36.0-nightly.20260318 - Subagents and Security Improvements
description: Enabled subagents functionality, added SandboxManager for process-spawning tool sandboxing, implemented Linux sandbox with bubblewrap and seccomp. Added cryptographic integrity verification for extension updates, customizable keyboard shortcuts, and improved subagent tool isolation. Fixed JIT context bugs and added CJK input support.

community_feedback.quote: Built-in subagents can't be disabled - subagent tools are being registered incorrectly
This AI model hasn't responded to a simple message for an hour

title: Version 2.1.78 - Plugin Persistent State and Terminal Notifications
description: Added StopFailure hook event, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} variable for plugin persistent state, and effort/maxTurns/disallowedTools frontmatter support for plugin-shipped agents. Terminal notifications now reach outer terminal when running inside tmux. Fixed multiple permission and sandbox issues.

community_feedback.quote: After updating to version 2.1.78, error: No available accounts: this group only allows Claude Code clients. Downgrading to 2.1.77 with same configuration works normally

title: GPT-5.3-Codex Long-Term Support
description: Announced GPT-5.3-Codex LTS (Long-Term Support) and base model changes. GPT-5.3-Codex will become the base model for all Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans by May 17, 2026.

title: Version 2.1.77 - Increased Token Limits and Performance Improvements
description: Increased default maximum output token limits for Claude Opus 4.6 to 64k tokens, with upper bound increased to 128k tokens. Added /color command and session name display. Fixed auto-updater memory leak and improved startup performance. Renamed /fork to /branch.

title: Version 0.115.0 - GPT-5.4 Mini Support
description: Added support for GPT-5.4 mini model, full-resolution images support, JS REPL enhancements, and improved subagent reliability. Users need to update CLI to access GPT-5.4 mini.

community_feedback.quote: After upgrading to codex-cli 0.115.0, prompts for approval on almost every command, including safe read-only commands like find and sed
Reports of slow response times (taking over 10 minutes for simple requests), CLI becoming unresponsive
gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.3-codex are no longer accessible via Codex CLI, concerns about model downgrades

title: Cascade AI Agent Feature Updates
description: Windsurf continues to develop Cascade, an AI agent that codes, fixes and thinks ahead. The changelog includes patch fixes, sign up improvements, and previews feature enhancements.

community_feedback.quote: Despite Cascade's reasoning capabilities, autocomplete can fail to trigger, respond inconsistently, or lag badly

title: Updates for Students - New Copilot Student Plan
description: Students with GitHub Education benefits moved to the new GitHub Copilot Student plan with updated features and benefits.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot changed their mind about student dev pack participants. Students described the new plan as a watered down version compared to what they previously had
No access to LTS models - Students cannot access the GPT-5.3-Codex LTS model, which is reserved for paying Business/Enterprise tiers

title: Plugin Marketplace with 30+ New Integrations
description: Added more than 30 new plugins from major partners including Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, Glean, Hugging Face, monday.com, and PlanetScale. Plugins contain MCPs that cloud agents can use when triggered manually or through automations.

community_feedback.quote: I tried Cursor's new plugin marketplace with Notion, Figma, Team Kit integrations

title: Version 0.114.0 - Experimental Code Mode and Hooks Engine
description: Introduced experimental code mode for more isolated coding workflows with stricter workflow isolation boundaries. Added hooks engine for automation capabilities. Enhanced functionality as a local coding agent.

community_feedback.quote: Codex CLI 0.114.0 introduces experimental code mode, hooks engine - complete transformation rather than incremental improvements

title: Agentic Capabilities Improvements for JetBrains IDEs
description: Enhanced core agentic capabilities including custom features, UX refinements, and quality improvements based on community feedback for JetBrains IDEs.

title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Support
description: Devin can now be installed as a desktop and mobile Progressive Web App. Users can install it by opening app.devin.ai in Chrome or Edge for a more native app-like experience.
